capabilities: Render block references and embeds inline with source updates
Search blocks vault-wide via @ and insert block links
Hide block ids and protect them from Enter, Backspace and Delete
Move the cursor Roam-style within list items
Restore cursor and scroll position when reopening files
disambiguation: Not an outline or indentation-guide plugin; since 1.0.2 it only handles inline block references, block search, id protection and cursor behavior.
extras: Interface text is currently Chinese only. The plugin patches Obsidian's file-opening flow and calls internal global-search APIs, which may break after major Obsidian updates. Two settings are marked experimental.
intentEvidence: 它把块引用渲染成行内文本，并让光标在列表里的移动更符合直觉。
problem: Obsidian renders block references and embeds on their own lines, leaves trailing ^ids exposed and easy to destroy with Enter or Backspace, and has no way to search and insert blocks from anywhere while typing.
summary: Inline block references with @ vault-wide block search, block id protection, and Roam-style cursor and Enter behavior in lists.
